review_note: Original 7292–7307 establishes IFF for left exact F:A→B,G:B→C with enough injectives in A,B: F maps every injective A-object to G-right-acyclic IFF canonical R(GF)→RG∘RF is an ISOMORPHISM of D+(A)→D+(C) functors. Stage A retains both directions and canonical-map orientation.
statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{B}, \mathcal{C}$ be abelian categories.
Let $F : \mathcal{A} \to \mathcal{B}$ and $G : \mathcal{B} \to \mathcal{C}$
be left exact functors. Assume $\mathcal{A}$, $\mathcal{B}$ have
enough injectives. The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $F(I)$ is right acyclic for $G$ for each injective object $I$
of $\mathcal{A}$, and
\item the canonical map
$$
t : R(G \circ F) \longrightarrow RG \circ RF.
$$
is isomorphism of functors from $D^{+}(\mathcal{A})$ to $D^{+}(\mathcal{C})$.
\end{enumerate}

enough injectives. The following are equivalent
\begin{enumerate}
\item $F(I)$ is right acyclic for $G$ for each injective object $I$
of $\mathcal{A}$, and
\item the canonical map
$$
t : R(G \circ F) \longrightarrow RG \circ RF.

\end{enumerate}
